medicare_prescription_payment_plan.exists_2026: Yes, located as an available payment option.
medicare_prescription_payment_plan.what_it_does_located: Spreads out-of-pocket Part D drug costs into monthly payments across the calendar year. It does not save money or lower drug costs.
medicare_prescription_payment_plan.timing_note_located: Can be joined at any time in the year; starting earlier (before September) gives more months to spread costs.
medicare_prescription_payment_plan.APPLIES_TO_THESE_DRUGS: UNRESOLVED AND CONSEQUENTIAL. The MPPP applies to drugs covered under the Part D benefit. GATE-BRIDGE established that Medicare GLP-1 Bridge drugs are furnished OUTSIDE the Part D benefit payment flow, that the Part D deductible does not apply, and that no part of the $50 copay counts toward TrOOP.
